label: Level
description: country, county or sub-county (the workbook's own words: County, Sub County)

label: County
description: The county a sub-county lies in (column A as the workbook writes it); empty for the country and the counties

label: Unit
description: The unit's name as the workbook writes it (column B for sub-counties, column A for counties); a double space inside 13 names written as one

label: Men
description: Male population, August 2019 census (column D, Male)

label: Women
description: Female population, August 2019 census (column E, Female)

label: Total
description: Population, all persons, August 2019 census (column C, Total)

label: Total less men and women
description: Computed here: total minus men minus women. The workbook has no intersex column; the 2019 census counted intersex persons, which this difference may hold, but the workbook does not say so

label: Land area
description: Column F, SQ.Km; for counties and the country, the sum of their sub-county rows

label: Population density
description: Column G, Pop density, as printed; empty where printed as - or .., and for the derived county and country rows

label: Table
description: The workbook sheet the row was read from; empty for a derived row

label: Cells
description: The workbook cells the row was read from; empty for a derived row

label: Read from
description: cells, or what is unusual about the row: a derived sum, a value printed as - or .., a name respaced, or a row read from text
